stem.text: A metal wire is connected between the terminals of a cell so that there is a current in the wire.

A.text: Negatively charged electrons in the wire move from the negative terminal to the positive terminal.

B.text: Negatively charged nuclei in the wire move from the negative terminal to the positive terminal.

C.text: Positively charged electrons in the wire move from the positive terminal to the negative terminal.

D.text: Positively charged nuclei in the wire move from the positive terminal to the negative terminal.
